uniteDbPokemon.notes: Unite-DB public pokemon.json. v3 enumerates skills, boosted basic attacks, nested upgrade choices, Plus/enhanced effects, Unite Moves, and Unite Buffs.

sourceList.originalDescription: When Mamoswine deals damage, Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 5s, stacking up to 3 times. When Mamoswine uses Ice Shard, Icicle Crash or Ice Fang, the next auto attack is boosted. If any of these moves creates a freezing area of effect inside an ally goal zone, the goal-scoring speed of enemies is decreased by 30% for 5s. When Mamoswine deals damage, Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. When Mamoswine uses Ice Shard, Icicle Crash or Ice Fang, the next basic attack is boosted. If any of these moves creates a freezing area of effect inside an ally goal zone, the goal-scoring speed of enemies is decreased.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage and freezing enemies for 0.5s when it hits. Freezing an enemy causes the user’s auto attacks to deal increased damage to them for 3s. Reapplying a freeze will refresh this duration. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage and freezing enemies for a short time when it hits. Mamoswine's basic attacks deal increased damage for a short time to enemies recently frozen with one of Mamoswine's moves.

Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage and freezing enemies for a short time when it hits. Mamoswine's basic attacks deal increased damage for a short time to enemies recently frozen with one of Mamoswine's moves.

Hurls 3 chunks of ice at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 40% for 1.5s. If an enemy is hit by all three chunks, they're left frozen for 0.5s. Hurls 3 chunks of ice at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If an enemy is hit by all three chunks, they're left frozen for a short time.

Drops icicles on the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 35% for 0.2s. The final icicle shatters after 1s or when hit by Mamoswine's other moves or boosted attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them frozen for 1.5s if the icicle was shattered by Mamoswine, or 1s if it shattered on its own. If the icicle is shattered by Tackle or High Horsepower, the ground is covered in ice, which increases the movement speed of allies that run over it by 50%. The next auto attack is boosted. Drops icicles on the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. The final icicle shatters after a set amount of time or when hit by Mamoswine's other moves or boosted attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them frozen. If the icicle is shattered by Tackle or High Horsepower, the ground is covered in ice, which increases the movement speed of allies that run over it. The next basic attack is boosted.
The final icicle leaves enemies hit unable to act for .2s. The final icicle leaves enemies hit unable to act for a short time.

Uses cold-infused fangs to throw the enemy closest to Mamoswine, dealing damage and grabbing them, rendering them unable to act. Mamoswine can then designate a direction to slam the thrown Pokémon forward or backward, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and freezing them. The thrown Pokémon is frozen for 1s, and surrounding enemies are frozen for 1.5s. The next auto attack is boosted. Uses cold-infused fangs to throw the opposing Pokémon closest to the user, dealing damage and leaving them frozen for a short time. The user can then designate a direction to slam the thrown Pokémon forward or backward, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them frozen for a short time. The next basic attack is boosted.
Increases the area of effect in which enemies are left frozen after the slam attack. Increases the area of effect in which enemies are left frozen after the slam attack.

Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction; dealing damage to enemies hit and throws them in the air for 0.5s. Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies they hit and throws them in the air.

Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies they hit and shoving them for 0.55s. Mamoswine then stomps their feet, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for 0.35s. This stomping deals increased damage to frozen enemies. Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies they hit and shove them. Mamoswine then stomps their feet, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for a short time. This stomping deals increased damage to frozen enemies.
Increases the reckless rush's speed and the length of time enemies are left unable to act by .2s. Increases the reckless rush's speed and the length of time enemies are left unable to act.

Mamoswine leaps up in the designated direction and lands forcefully, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and pulling them toward Mamoswine. Enemies that are hit cannot act for 1s. Mamoswine leaps up in the designated direction and lands forcefully, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and pulling them toward Mamoswine.

Decreases movement speed of enemies by 30% for 2.5s when this move hits and increases the move's pulling power. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits and increases the move's pulling power.

Mamoswine jumps to the designated location then repeatedly stomps the ground four times, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for 0.5s with each stomp. The first stomp slows enemies by 30%, the two mini stomps slow them by 20%, and the final stomp slows them by 40% and throws them in the air for 1.5s. Mamoswine is unstoppable for the duration of the move. Mamoswine jumps to the designated location and becomes immune to hindrances - then repeatedly stomps the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time with each stomp. The final stomp throws enemies in the air.
Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 40% Max HP Shield Buff duration: 6

source.name: Mammoth Mash
source.originalDescription: Mamoswine jumps to the designated location then repeatedly stomps the ground four times, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for 0.5s with each stomp. The first stomp slows enemies by 30%, the two mini stomps slow them by 20%, and the final stomp slows them by 40% and throws them in the air for 1.5s. Mamoswine is unstoppable for the duration of the move. Mamoswine jumps to the designated location and becomes immune to hindrances - then repeatedly stomps the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time with each stomp. The final stomp throws enemies in the air.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Mammoth Mash は 相手を打ち上げる、移動速度を下げる、妨害無効になる、妨害耐性を得る。
